facts.fact: Kasi Cloud Datacenters held the flag-off of its Lekki, Lagos campus, whose first building LOS1 is engineered for high-density AI and accelerated computing and moves through phased commissioning toward full commercial operations; no GPU installation is stated.
The Nigeria Sovereign Investment Authority's release says Nigeria's National Cloud Policy 2025 (NCP2025) mandates in-country hosting for sensitive government and financial data.

Kasi lists a direct TCN 132kV power connection and hybrid gas, solar and battery supply with N+1 redundancy for its Lekki campus, which it says is open for business with phased commissioning continuing.

Kasi Cloud Datacenters says its Lekki campus opens a sovereign cloud and AI infrastructure option to Nigerian enterprises, financial institutions and government agencies, and NSIA's chief executive calls LOS1 AI-ready and open for business, while phased commissioning continues.
